name: Val'ty
storyline:
The Valtians are a species feared throughout the galaxy for being ruthless and independent, known for their unbridled hostility towards anyone who interferes with their sovereignty.

With humanity always fearful of The Valtian power, an organization introduced a machine capable of converting rebellious alien races into loyal servants of humanity, and Valtians are the most requested species to be "domesticated".

Val'ty, an ordinary Valtian, an exemplary citizen with an extensive list of crimes against humans, will be in charge of destroying the machine and everything else in her path.

But wait, her daughter is coming along.
summary:
An retro first-person shooter about an "evil" alien mother and her daughter.
Inspired by Turok, MDK, Chasm: The Rift and ARG elements, Val'ty crosses the galaxy unlocking new powers, doing silly alien activities and asserting her dominance.
Nothing will stand between her and her kin.
